VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria explicitly requires "all 31 tests pass," which is a verifiable, objective requirement. The only evidence provided is a self-report (SELF provenance class) with no attached artifacts—no CI logs, test results, diffs, or independent verification. A self-report alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria that demand demonstrable test passage, as there is no way to independently verify the claimed outcome.
